name: sakal-automation
description: Agent automation for sakal-dev repos: automation-install onboards a repo end to end (<30 min, no hand-written YAML); automation-operate runs the queue day to day; automation-dispatch (draft) hands briefs to cloud executors; sakal-import turns a repo's specs and open issues into SakalMaster journeys/epics/stories/ACs/bugs/tasks (idempotent, re-runnable). Engine: sakal-dev/automation reusable workflows @v1.
